assessment: This valuable work reports a unique N-terminal motif of Staphylococcus aureus GpsB, the co-crystal structure of GpsB with the C-terminus of PBP4, and the direct interaction between GpsB and the C-terminus of FtsZ. The evidence supporting these discoveries is convincing, with biochemical and structural characterizations. This study sheds light on the role of GpsB in the cell division of this important pathogen.
